say:8:1010014101:0.text: You seem more interested in who started the fire than in putting it out.
say:8:1010014101:0.source_cn: 比起灭火，你们对纵火者是谁更感兴趣，对吗？

say:9:1010014102:0.text: I saw you casting a spell with my own eyes!
say:9:1010014102:0.source_cn: 纵火犯，我亲眼看到你在施法！

say:10:1010014103:0.text: It's not that easy to quench a greedy fire, my dear. I'm just trying to help.
say:10:1010014103:0.source_cn: 让一团贪婪燃烧的火停下来可没那么容易，亲爱的，我只是在...

say:11:1010014104:0.text:
The Scarlet Sorceress is as beautiful as her fire is dangerous.
That's what the rumors say...
say:11:1010014104:0.source_cn: 灰烬魔女有多美丽，她的火焰就有多危险……\n真见鬼，果...

say:12:1010014105:0.text:
Dangerous? You're quite right.
If this were my fire, you'd all be ashes by now...
say:12:1010014105:0.source_cn: 危险？你说的没错。\n如果这是我的火焰，你、你们，早是...

say:16:1010014106:0.text: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...
say:16:1010014106:0.source_cn: 原来她就是灰烬魔女。主人，满满听过她的名号。
say:16:1010014106:0.male: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...
say:16:1010014106:0.female: So she's the Scarlet Sorceress! Chippy has heard of her...

say:21:1010014109:0.text:
Hm?!
Magister, if Chippy is not mistaken... it seems like the Scarlet Sorceress is staring at you.
say:21:1010014109:0.source_cn: 咦？！\n主人，如果满满没看错的话……灰烬魔女好像……...
say:21:1010014109:0.male:
Hm?!
Magister, if Chippy is not mistaken... it seems like the Scarlet Sorceress is staring at you.
say:21:1010014109:0.female:
Hm?!
Magister, if Chippy is not mistaken... it seems like the Scarlet Sorceress is staring at you.

say:22:1010014110:0.text: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!
say:22:1010014110:0.source_cn: 怎么办啊主人？她真的在盯着您！
say:22:1010014110:0.male: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!
say:22:1010014110:0.female: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!

choice_prompt:23:1010014110.text: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!
choice_prompt:23:1010014110.source_cn: 怎么办啊主人？她真的在盯着您！
choice_prompt:23:1010014110.male: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!
choice_prompt:23:1010014110.female: What do we do, Magister? She's staring really hard!

say:24:1010014111:0.text: ... Never mind. You made me think of someone.

say:25:1010014112:0.text: The divination was right. This night was awful. I shouldn't have gone out.
say:25:1010014112:0.source_cn: 占卜的结果一点也没错，这是个多灾多难的夜晚，我不该出门。

say:26:1010014113:0.text: I'd appreciate not being disturbed any further. I'm leaving.
say:26:1010014113:0.source_cn: 可以的话，还请各位别再叨扰我，我想离开了。

say:29:1010014114:0.text: You're not going anywhere, Scarlet Sorceress! All my wares are gone! I demand compensation!
say:29:1010014114:0.source_cn: 灰烬魔女，你不能走！我的货物全都被烧毁了，我需要补偿！

say:30:1010014115:0.text: Don't push your luck, young man. I'm not known for my patience.
say:30:1010014115:0.source_cn: 可不要得寸进尺哦，小弟弟，我不是一个很有耐心的人。

say:31:1010014116:0.text: Don't you dare try to get away with this! I'll make sure you're held responsible!
say:31:1010014116:0.source_cn: 你别想逃脱罪责，我一定会追究到底！

say:32:1010014117:0.source_cn: 嘘……你先安静点。\n这周围的情况似乎不太对劲。

say:33:1010014118:0.text: The wind... It's suddenly so loud.

narration:36:1010023:0.text: You find yourselves at the heart of the fire, witnessing a heated argument between the villagers and a red-haired woman.
narration:36:1010023:0.source_cn: 你们来到火灾中心，看见村民们正在和一位红发魔女争执。
